I implemented `slugify` in `textutil.py`, and `cx-route test` now passes.

**What changed**
- [textutil.py:3](file:///root/.cx-wt/textutil-live-agy-1/textutil.py#L3): added `import re`.
- [textutil.py:12](file:///root/.cx-wt/textutil-live-agy-1/textutil.py#L12): replaced `raise NotImplementedError` with `return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text.lower()).strip("-")`. It lowercases the text, turns every run of anything other than ASCII letters and digits into a single hyphen, and removes hyphens at the start and end. This is what the docstring describes.

- `cx-route test`: 3 tests ran, all passed.
